people.name: Annan Zhou
people.title: Professor
people.researchFocus: Geomechanics and geotechnical engineering: unsaturated and expansive soils, critical-state soil mechanics and constitutive modelling, soil-structure interaction for wind turbine foundations, and risk assessment for geotechnical infrastructure.

people.name: Majid Nazem
people.title: Professor
people.researchFocus: Computational geomechanics: adaptive finite element and meshless methods for soil-structure interaction, offshore geomechanics, foundation penetration problems and mining-induced subsidence.

people.name: Jie Li
people.title: Professor; Discipline Leader, Geomechanics and Transport
people.researchFocus: Sustainable geotechnics, expansive soil behaviour and footing interaction, ground improvement and soil stabilisation, plus recycling of waste materials into pavement and construction materials.

people.name: Chun Qing Li
people.title: Professor
people.researchFocus: Time-dependent reliability theory and whole-of-life management of corrosion-prone infrastructure, including mixed-mode fracture of buried pipes and risk-cost optimised maintenance planning.

people.name: Sara Moridpour
people.title: Professor
people.researchFocus: Traffic safety analysis, driving behaviour prediction, transport system modelling using AI and machine learning, and management of transport infrastructure assets.

people.name: Kate Nguyen
people.title: Professor; Deputy Head of Department (Research and Innovation)
people.researchFocus: Leads the Innovative Fire and Facade Engineering Group: fire-safe and sustainable construction materials, flame-retardant composites, facade fire performance and advanced building solutions.

people.name: Kevin (Guomin) Zhang
people.title: Professor; Dean, School of Engineering
people.researchFocus: Sustainable construction and asset management, life cycle assessment of built assets, BIM-enabled construction management, and modular and low-carbon building delivery.

people.name: Jonathan Tran
people.title: Associate Professor
people.researchFocus: Sustainable digital construction and 3D printing of cementitious and smart materials, bio-inspired and lattice structures, and lightweight structural systems for extreme loading protection.

people.name: Muhammed Bhuiyan
people.title: Senior Lecturer
people.researchFocus: Water resources and hydrology: flood estimation and forecasting, urban drainage and WSUD, groundwater management and recharge, drought analysis, and microplastic removal in stormwater and wastewater.

people.name: Mahmud Ashraf
people.title: Professor
people.researchFocus: Structural use of renewable bio-based materials such as engineered timber and bamboo, hybrid structural systems, and the Continuous Strength Method for stainless and high-strength steel.

people.name: Kazem Ghabraie
people.title: Associate Professor
people.researchFocus: Topology and shape optimisation, lattice and multiscale structures, connection design and optimisation, and sustainable or recycled materials in construction and timber engineering.

people.name: Riyadh Al-Ameri
people.title: Senior Lecturer in Civil Engineering
people.researchFocus: Decarbonising construction through green concretes containing recycled glass, plastics and construction waste, geopolymer concrete for tunnel linings, and strengthening of structures with advanced composites such as CFRP.

people.name: Ashim Debnath
people.title: Professor of Transportation Engineering; Associate Head of School (Research)
people.researchFocus: Road safety and traffic management: vulnerable road users, roadworks and temporary traffic management, incident response vehicle design and intersection safety treatments. Directs the Safe Future Mobility Research Lab.

people.name: Lloyd Hock Chye Chua
people.title: Associate Professor of Civil Engineering
people.researchFocus: Urban hydrology, rainfall-runoff and water quality monitoring and modelling, surface water quality processes, and contaminated sediment assessment.

people.name: Susanga Costa
people.title: Senior Lecturer, Civil - Geotechnical Engineering
people.researchFocus: Expansive soil behaviour, desiccation cracking and bio-cementation for crack healing, sustainable soil stabilisation with recycled waste, and climate change effects on geo-infrastructure.

people.name: James (Jinzhe) Gong
people.title: Senior Lecturer
people.researchFocus: Smart water and sewer networks for predictive asset management, hydraulic transient-based pipe condition screening, premise plumbing and water demand estimation, and climate adaptation of water infrastructure.

people.name: Dong Ngoduy
people.title: Professor; Head of Transport Engineering
people.researchFocus: Traffic flow theory for multi-class and connected traffic systems, AI and machine learning for short-term traffic prediction and network optimisation, and connected and autonomous vehicle control.

people.name: Jayantha Kodikara
people.title: Professor
people.researchFocus: Unsaturated soil mechanics and desiccation cracking, geo-infrastructure and buried pipeline systems, and pavement materials including moisture sensing for intelligent compaction.

people.name: Colin Caprani
people.title: Associate Professor
people.researchFocus: Bridge engineering: highway bridge traffic loading for short- and long-span bridges, vibration serviceability and human-structure interaction on footbridges, structural reliability and health monitoring.

people.name: Ye Lu
people.title: Associate Professor
people.researchFocus: Structural health monitoring and smart structures, using advanced signal processing and artificial intelligence for damage detection, plus non-destructive assessment of facades and bridges.

people.name: Nan Zheng
people.title: Associate Professor
people.researchFocus: Traffic flow theory, traffic big data, urban traffic operation and control, multi-modal traffic management, and connected and autonomous vehicle systems at the Institute of Transport Studies.

people.name: Arash Zamyadi
people.title: Senior Lecturer
people.researchFocus: Water treatment: cyanobacterial and algal bloom risk management, real-time water quality monitoring, AI-based microorganism identification, pathogen monitoring and PFAS removal.
